prompts.title: Recent Form Split
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16 analytic motion-graphics sequence, 7 seconds. Layout: top title 'Italia vs Turquía · Forma reciente' in warm white #edf0e6; below, two team columns with Spanish labels 'Italia' and 'Turquía'. Main chart: grouped count bars for wins, draws and losses over each available recent sample, with Spanish category labels 'Victorias', 'Empates', 'Derrotas'. Use a shared zero baseline and common count scale in partidos. Each group is built from {{home.wins}}, {{home.draws}}, {{home.losses}} for Italia and {{away.wins}}, {{away.draws}}, {{away.losses}} for Turquía. Clearly show sample sizes {{home.n}} and {{away.n}}; if samples are unequal, add a small slate #8ca6bf badge 'muestras distintas' beside the team name. Bars: wins lime #c5ed74, draws slate #8ca6bf, losses warm white #edf0e6 with charcoal #101412 outline. Entry: title fades first, then bars grow upward from baseline in staggered order, labels count up. Main comparison: Italia versus Turquía category counts. Emphasis: the largest category receives a soft lime pulse, while the baseline and axis labels stay static. Camera: slow push-in from full frame to chart area, then settle. Source/sample annotation: bottom line above subtitles reads 'Fuente: Bzzoiro · muestra reciente' with exact sample placeholders attached. Transition: wipe from left to right at the end. Exit: bars compress to baseline and title fades. Reserve lower quarter for permanent yellow subtitles. Keep one focal point: the grouped bars. No forecasts, only historical counts.

prompts.title: Goals For and Against
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16 analytic motion-graphics sequence, 8 seconds. Layout: title 'Goles en la muestra reciente' in warm white #edf0e6; subtitle 'Italia vs Turquía'. Main chart: paired horizontal bars for each team, with Spanish labels 'Goles a favor' and 'Goles recibidos'. Use a shared goals scale in goles, zero baseline at left, gridlines in slate #8ca6bf at low opacity. Italia pair uses {{home.gf}} and {{home.ga}}; Turquía pair uses {{away.gf}} and {{away.ga}}. Attach sample sizes {{home.n}} and {{away.n}} as small chips near team names, and label the chart unit 'goles'. Football context: small pitch-line motif in charcoal #101412 background, no decorative balls that compete with data. Entry: title slides down, then paired bars extend horizontally from zero, value labels fade in. Main comparison: goals for versus goals against for both teams, same unit. Emphasis: the larger goals-against value gets a warm white outline and a brief lime #c5ed74 underline; the larger goals-for value gets a lime tick. Camera: gentle vertical drift from top to center, then hold. Source/sample annotation: a source line reads 'Fuente: Bzzoiro · últimos partidos' and sample chips remain visible. Transition: cross-dissolve to a clean slate #8ca6bf frame. Exit: bars retract to zero baseline and title fades. Reserve lower quarter for permanent yellow subtitles. Keep hierarchy: one chart, one focal pair at a time.

prompts.title: Clean Sheets Versus Sample

Main chart: two vertical count bars, one per team, for clean sheets. Use a shared count scale in partidos and a zero baseline. Italia bar uses {{home.clean}}; Turquía bar uses {{away.clean}}. Do not convert these counts into rates or fractions of the sample. Place sample-size chips beside each team: {{home.n}} and {{away.n}}, labelled 'Partidos'. If a supplied count is zero, render the exact supplied value from the fact placeholder as a thin empty bar with the numeric label from the renderer, without inventing an axis or extra value. Entry: background charcoal #101412 fades in, baseline draws first, bars rise from zero with lime #c5ed74 for the first and slate #8ca6bf for the second, then labels appear. Main comparison: clean-sheet counts alongside their samples, same unit. Emphasis: the larger clean-sheet count gets a soft warm-white halo; sample chips stay secondary. Camera: locked-off frame with a slight parallax on the title. Source/sample annotation: bottom source line 'Fuente: Bzzoiro · muestra de partidos' with exact sample placeholders. Transition: vertical wipe from top to bottom. Exit: bars fade downward and title dissolves. Reserve lower quarter for permanent yellow subtitles. No rates, only counts.

prompts.title: Grounded Statistical Tension
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16 analytic motion-graphics sequence, 9 seconds. Layout: split vertical board, top band 'Forma reciente', lower band 'Cruces previos'. Top band uses Spanish labels 'Italia' and 'Turquía' with two compact count strips: for Italia show {{home.wins}} 'Victorias', {{home.losses}} 'Derrotas' and {{home.clean}} 'Arcos en cero'; for Turquía show {{away.wins}} 'Victorias', {{away.losses}} 'Derrotas' and {{away.clean}} 'Arcos en cero'. All values are counts in partidos, never rates. Attach samples {{home.n}} and {{away.n}} as slate #8ca6bf chips. Lower band uses Spanish labels 'Cruces previos': Italia wins {{h2h.homeWins}}, Turquía wins {{h2h.awayWins}}, draws {{h2h.draws}}, total sample {{h2h.total}}. The grounded tension: recent counts and historical counts are shown side by side as separate blocks, not merged into a forecast. Because the catalogue does not supply published model estimates, use only historical catalogue facts and label the board 'Conteos históricos'. Entry: top band builds first with bars growing from zero, then lower band slides up. Main comparison: same-unit counts across both bands; emphasis on the largest positive count in each band with a lime #c5ed74 pulse. Camera: slow push-in to the seam between bands, then hold. Source/sample annotation: source line 'Fuente: Bzzoiro · muestras históricas' with sample chips visible. Transition: dip-to-charcoal wipe between bands. Exit: both bands compress to baseline and title fades. Reserve lower quarter for permanent yellow subtitles. No predictions, no estimates, one focal tension.
